text: Mahishasura defeated Indra, Agni, Vayu, and all the other Devas.
The Devas then turned to Brahma, Vishnu, and Shiva for help.
But neither Vishnu nor Shiva stepped forward to fight Mahishasura alone.
Instead, the radiance of every Deva merged into one powerful form.
And from that unified light, Devi manifested.
The Durga Saptashati is teaching us that some battles cannot be won by strength alone.
They require Wisdom, Compassion, Discipline, Courage, and Patience — all working together.
